segments.name: North America
segments.description: Sells commercial laundry systems, service parts and aftermarket services to distributors, institutional end users and communal laundry operators in the United States and Canada.
segments.evidence: Our North America segment consists of the United States and Canada.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Sells commercial laundry systems and service parts through independent distributors and direct sales offices across Europe, Brazil, Latin America and Asia Pacific.
segments.evidence: Our International segment comprises all countries outside of the United States and Canada.

revenueModel.text: Distributors and end customers, including laundromat owners and institutions, pay for commercial laundry systems, service parts and equipment financing.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of our commercial-grade laundry systems and service parts across our two geographic segments and into the three end markets of OPL, Vended and Commercial In-Home.
